# Reproduce the ARMD Tableau susceptibility mart with tidyverse transformations.
# Step 1: import and stage the original cultures CSV.
# Later steps will be appended to this same script after inspecting this output.
#
# Suggested repository location: R/build_mart_susceptibility.R
# Run from the repository root. Change raw_data_file to your existing CSV path;
# there is no need to move or duplicate the source data.
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

raw_data_file = "../data/raw/microbiology_cultures_cohort.csv"
source_release = "2025-04-11"
```
# Match the scope recorded in the supplied Tableau CSV.
# Define these now, but apply the window after resolving culture-level fields.

```{r}
analysis_window_start = as.Date("2023-01-01")
analysis_window_end_exclusive = analysis_window_start %m+% months(12)
```

# Import as text so patient/order identifiers are preserved and field cleaning
# is explicit. Blank CSV fields become NA; the literal "Null" is handled below.
# Do not let read_csv trim the raw AST category before we preserve it.

```{r}
raw_armd =
  read_csv(
    raw_data_file,
    col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
    na = "",
    trim_ws = FALSE
  ) %>%
  janitor::clean_names()
```

# Keep one row per original source row. Do not drop missing AST records or
# deduplicate yet: those records affect reconciliation and reporting coverage.

```{r}
armd_staged =
  raw_armd %>%
  transmute(
    source_version = source_release,
    patient_key = anon_id,
    encounter_key = pat_enc_csn_id_coded,
    culture_order_key = order_proc_id_coded,
    order_time_jittered_utc_raw = order_time_jittered_utc,
    culture_time_shifted = ymd_hms(
      order_time_jittered_utc,
      tz = "UTC",
      quiet = TRUE
    ),
    ordering_mode = na_if(str_trim(ordering_mode), "Null"),
    culture_description = na_if(str_trim(culture_description), "Null"),
    was_positive = as.integer(na_if(str_trim(was_positive), "Null")),
    organism = na_if(str_trim(organism), "Null"),
    antibiotic = na_if(str_trim(antibiotic), "Null"),
    susceptibility_raw = susceptibility,
    susceptibility = str_trim(na_if(susceptibility, "Null"))
  )
```

# Inspect the first stage before building the reporting population.
# A nonzero timestamp_parse_failures count needs review before proceeding.
# The dates are shifted research timestamps, not verified clinical dates.

```{r}
import_check =
  armd_staged %>%
  summarise(
    source_rows = n(),
    timestamp_parse_failures = sum(
      !is.na(order_time_jittered_utc_raw) &
        !(order_time_jittered_utc_raw %in% c("", "Null")) &
        is.na(culture_time_shifted)
    ),
    missing_patient_keys = sum(is.na(patient_key)),
    missing_order_keys = sum(is.na(culture_order_key))
  )

print(import_check)
glimpse(armd_staged)

armd_staged %>%
  count(culture_description, sort = TRUE) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

# This is the first stage only; it does not yet generate the final mart.
# Next: resolve culture-level fields and repeated AST endpoints.
